summary: High Tech Source is the source of talent for the Dutch tech industry., founded in 2020. Type: startup / scale-up. About 12 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: High Tech Source is a small Dutch recruitment agency started by former ASML recruiters, placing engineers in high-tech firms; it is a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: A small team of about 12 recruiters, founded in 2020 and based in Utrecht.
It recruits for high-tech clients in semiconductors, life sciences, automotive and aerospace, offering permanent, flex and interim placements.

open.text: High Tech Source B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: As a recruitment agency, the job you apply for may be at one of its client companies rather than at High Tech Source itself.
